text: Final Compliance Audit Report from BDO Canada LLP for candidate Lorenzo Berardinetti. Agenda materials will be made available at the meeting.

The Compliance Audit Committee considered the apparent contraventions identified in the audit report prepared by BDO Canada LLP, of the election campaign finances of Lorenzo Berardinetti and has decided not to commence a legal proceeding against the candidate for the apparent contraventions. 1. As a preliminary matter, the Compliance Audit Committee (the “Committee”) considered the request and approved the request to redact personal information of the candidate Lorenzo Berardinetti (the “Candidate”) contained in the: a. Compliance Audit Report (the “Report”) and presentation slide deck (the “Presentation”) from BDO Canada LLP (the “Auditor”), who conducted a review of the election campaign finances of the Candidate, and b. Candidate’s written submission in part, dated November 8, 2024. 2. The Committee has a strong interest in ensuring that hearings are open to the public. However, the…
